question: Will Russia and Ukraine sign a formal ceasefire or peace agreement before December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if, between today and December 31, 2026 (inclusive), official representatives of both the Russian and Ukrainian governments sign a written agreement establishing a general ceasefire or ending the war, as reported by at least two major international news outlets (e.g. Reuters, AP, BBC). Local, humanitarian, or energy-only truces do not count. Otherwise resolves NO.
background: Test question for the geopolitical forecaster.
